# Evaluation selection report template

**Status: NOT EVALUATED. No provider calls, quality result, production selection,
account entitlement, or deployment is asserted by this template.**

Complete operational details in an access-controlled private report. A public
summary must omit secrets, private source, identities, raw provider payloads,
traces and deployment receipts. Never convert blank fields into fabricated
measurements. Mark each check passed, failed, blocked, or not run.

## 1. Scope and authority

- Exact source commit / clean-tree proof: not recorded.
- Locked SDK wheel identity: not recorded.
- Public-only input provenance and allowed destination: not verified.
- Separate live-experiment authorization and hard budget: not granted here.
- Endpoint, exact model IDs, effort, transport and pricing version: not tested.
- Actual production identity and comparison baseline: unverified.
- Production activation authorization: not granted here.
- Plan hash / report date / evaluator: not recorded.

## 2. Corpus and contamination ledger

| Case ID | Exact head and input digest | Development or confirmation | Evidence available at review time | Adjudication basis | Prior exposure / limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Not materialized | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown |

Report missing coverage and correlated/near-duplicate cases. Distinguish
diagnostic defect-enriched cases from naturally sampled traffic. After tuning
on a confirmation case, reclassify it; do not reuse it as unseen confirmation.

## 3. Stage comparison

| Phase / tier | Candidate model / effort | Paired input digest | Supported material gains | Misses / false blockers / unnecessary owner work | Delivery or contract loss | Usage / latency / incomplete calls | Decision and uncertainty |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Not run | Not selected | Unknown | Not measured | Not measured | Not measured | Not measured | No decision |

Record both disagreements and agreements. A repeat is a separately accounted
observation, not permission for an unbounded retry. Explain whether a gain
comes from acquisition, engineering judgment, presentation, or publication.

## 4. Full-path confirmation

- All-Luna-max reference: not run.
- Leading mixed profile and profile version: not selected.
- Independent confirmation cases: not materialized.
- Natural Route output and observed tier mix: not measured.
- Original pipeline/tool/call/deadline bounds retained: not checked.
- Final preserves deciding findings and references: not checked.
- No provider or GitHub duplicate effects; exact-head/lifecycle checks: not checked.
- All failures, refusals, truncations, cancellations and unknown outcomes retained: not checked.
- Zero GitHub/AWS product-write proof for isolated qualification: not established.
- Remaining hard counterexamples and normal model variance: not assessed.

## 5. Usage and monthly forecast

Record actual traffic-window completeness and actual per-tier admitted runs;
do not substitute daily quota maxima. Use complete-path costs, not only Final
output length or a different provider's token counts.

| Quantity | Evidence / result |
| --- | --- |
| Observation period and missing data | Unknown |
| Actual admitted runs, successors and tier mix | Unknown |
| Per-stage calls, tokens, cache, retries/corrections | Unknown |
| Output total with reasoning as a breakdown, not an extra sum | Unknown |
| Paid failed/cancelled/superseded work | Unknown |
| Unknown usage and conservative pending reservation | Unknown |
| Measured gross usage versus account-reconciled cost | Unknown |
| Operator's allocated monthly envelope | Not supplied |
| Verified credits, expiry, cash boundary and other allocations | Unverified; private evidence only |
| Central monthly forecast | Not calculated |
| Observed-variation/cache/long-input stress scenario | Not calculated |
| Experimental spend charged to the same period | Not measured |
| Remaining headroom after pending work | Unknown |

## 6. Selection decision

- Hard-system gate: NOT RUN.
- Nondominated candidates: NOT ESTABLISHED.
- Selected phase/tier map: NONE.
- Why each Terra stage/effort earns its incremental cost: NOT ESTABLISHED.
- Where Luna medium is safe enough relative to max: NOT ESTABLISHED.
- Why expensive conditional arms were included or omitted: NOT RECORDED.
- Counterexamples, uncertainty and additional evidence that could change the choice: UNKNOWN.
- Defensible claim: offline planning only; no quality or cost improvement established.

Do not add a numeric accuracy claim from a small diagnostic set. Report the
best supported choice among tested candidates, not a global optimum. If equal
quality needs less budget, preserve the remaining allowance rather than spend
it to reach a target.

## 7. Release, observation and reevaluation handoff

- Exact release artifacts, checksums, CI and provenance: not checked.
- Verified prior deployment / state-compatible recovery: not checked.
- Financial-safe stop versus separately authorized paid fallback: not decided.
- Live observation scope, evidence and stopping condition: not specified.
- New model reevaluation: require official availability, paired capsules and
  full-path confirmation; no speculative or automatic model switch.

This report does not itself approve API execution or deployment.
